Describe the expected and actual behavior.

Include the xarray-cog version/commit, Python version, OS, export call and relevant error output. Provide a small synthetic xarray reproducer with dimensions, coordinates, dtype and CRS. For lazy or file-backed inputs, include the reader and Dask versions and chunk sizes. For output issues, include the relevant TIFF metadata and GDAL version when used.

Remove credentials and private URLs. Follow SECURITY.md for vulnerabilities.
